name: 3D in video
description: Use when a video needs a 3D element such as a device mockup or a logo spin: simple scenes, steady lighting, smooth camera moves, rendered locally, and only when 3D says something 2D can't.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: Make a 3d logo spin for the intro
Put my app in a device mockup
Fix the 3d physics bug in the game
